messages:
priya: onboarding note: brought up nova-embed-v2 (per-channel int4) on staging. latency gains look great but small-holdout recall@1 dropped ~6% vs fp16. posting quick triage.
toni: can you share exact eval config and dataset?
priya: eval: python eval_embeddings.py --model nova-embed-v2 --quant int4 --per_channel True --batch 192 --microbatch 24 --dataset small-holdout --k 1
raja: any pipeline changes (whitening, pooling, token truncation)?
priya: only change was we enabled compact pooling & reduced max_tokens 512->384 to hit p50 target.
toni: ok. what's baseline numbers?
priya: fp16 recall@1=0.681, int4 raw=0.643, int4+microbatch tweak=0.638. silhouette dropped fp16 0.37 -> int4 0.31.
ella: looks like magnitude collapse after quant. did you inspect embedding norms per-sample?
priya: yes: fp16 median norm=0.95, int4 median=0.57. histogram attached to onboarding dashboard.
raja: that explains ranking shifts. simple mitigation: post-quant L2 renorm to restore original norm distribution (scale each vector to fp16 median or per-shard median).
priya: re-ran with per-vector L2 renorm to fp16 median: recall@1=0.671, silhouette=0.365. throughput penalty ~+5% p99.
toni: much better. can we make renorm optional per-model and add a regression in the onboarding CI? Condition: small-holdout recall@1 within 2% of fp16 baseline.
priya: created task ENGML-1207 to default enable renorm for per-channel int4. added a canary job and uploaded pre/post norm histograms + NN failure examples to the model card.
raja: good. add a dashboard alert if centroid mean norm deviates >15% from fp16 during future quant jobs.
ops-bot: canary scheduled: nova-embed-v2 int4 -> dedicated-canary at 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z unless blocked.
ella: also note: compact pooling interacts with max_tokens. we should run pairwise ablation (pooling on/off x max_tokens 384/512) before finalizing. will add to the task.
priya: noted and running ablations tomorrow. closing triage for now.
